messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

This practice is avoided because in one large trial it was linked to adverse outcomes.
The adverse outcomes included more slow heartbeats, low blood pressure, strokes, and deaths.
Triplet: ["Avoiding high dose of extended-release Metoprolol before non-cardiac surgery", "has reason", "linked to adverse outcomes in one large trial"]

The relation 'has reason' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity is associated with the reason or cause specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'related to': The subject entity is associated with or connected to the medical condition or entity specified by the object entity.
B. 'located in': The subject entity is situated or based in the location specified by the object entity.
C. 'has symptom': The condition specified by the subject entity is associated with the symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'is a': The subject entity is categorized as the object entity.
E. 'can be': The subject condition or entity may be characterized by the object condition or entity.
F. None of the above.
